comp2.title: From Satellite Signals to Real-World Solutions
comp2.description: GNSS technologies support modern transportation, surveying, telecommunications, agriculture, environmental monitoring, disaster management and critical infrastructure. The GNSS Research Lab connects fundamental science with practical applications through advanced research, laboratory-based education, field experimentation and technology development.

cards.title: Research and Innovation
cards.description: Advancing GNSS algorithms, receiver technologies, precise positioning, augmentation, integrity monitoring, interference mitigation and resilient PNT solutions.

cards.title: Academic Excellence
cards.description: Supporting specialized undergraduate, master's and doctoral education through research-led teaching, laboratory experimentation and academic supervision.

cards.title: Digital Observation
cards.description: Transforming GNSS receiver measurements and scientific datasets into interactive visualizations of satellite signals, positioning performance, ionospheric conditions and space weather.

cards.title: Capacity Development
cards.description: Delivering GNSS schools, workshops, seminars and professional training for students, researchers, educators, engineers and practitioners.

comp4.title: About
comp4.subtitle: Our Foundation, Direction and People
comp4.description: Discover the Genesis, Vision, Mission and Strategic Objectives of the GNSS Research Lab. Meet the academic leadership, researchers and technical team advancing satellite navigation and PNT research.

comp5.title: Facilities
comp5.subtitle: Infrastructure for Observation and Precision
comp5.description: Explore research-grade GNSS receivers, multi-frequency antennas, software-defined radio platforms, processing software, the ICTP GNSS Station, the GISTM receiver, Academic CORS infrastructure and dedicated research workstations.

comp6.title: Research
comp6.subtitle: From Signals to Scientific Solutions
comp6.description: Learn about the Lab's research in constellation design, GNSS signals and receivers, precise positioning, augmentation, resilient PNT, integrated navigation, space weather and environmental applications. Access featured projects, publications and supervised research theses.

comp7.title: Digital Observatory
comp7.subtitle: A Digital Window into GNSS and Space Weather
comp7.description: Access interactive visualizations of satellite visibility, signal strength, skyplots, positioning stability, constellation status, Total Electron Content and atmospheric effects. The Space Weather Observatory connects solar activity, solar wind, geomagnetic conditions and ionospheric behaviour with GNSS performance.

comp8.title: Capacity Building
comp8.subtitle: Learning Beyond the Classroom
comp8.description: Explore GNSS schools, technical workshops, specialized training, seminars, webinars and conference activities designed to translate scientific knowledge into practical capability.

comp9.title: Collaborations
comp9.subtitle: Connecting Expertise and Expanding Impact
comp9.description: The Lab engages with academic institutions, government organizations, industry partners and international scientific networks through joint research, training, instrument deployment, data sharing and technology development.

comp10.title: Co-Pilot
comp10.subtitle: Intelligent Support for Learning and Research
comp10.description: GNSS Co-Pilot is an AI-assisted platform for exploring satellite-navigation concepts, positioning techniques, GNSS data formats and research workflows. It provides structured guidance for learners, researchers and practitioners.

comp11.title: Opportunities
comp11.subtitle: Learn, Research and Innovate with Us
comp11.description: Explore opportunities for graduate research, undergraduate projects, internships, research assistantships, professional training, visiting research and institutional partnerships.
